title: White into purple
line: Jim McFarland, cobbler: a white wool ball goes into dye and then to a pale new sole.
proof: Seen 58.4 million times, 328 times its usual

title: She watches the door
line: Taco-Bout-Joy's: the daughter films her mother waiting in the empty taco shop.
proof: Sold: 10-20 customers a day, then a line outside

title: The maker is the advert
line: Sparta Candle Co.: an old man shows a soap with peach slices he makes by hand.
proof: Sold: sales tripled in eight months of the series

title: Six hours, one wedding
line: Cobbler G throws a shoe, shows the hole and asks whether it can be done in time.
proof: Seen 16.2 million times; later films x3.49

title: The price over the plate
line: A dessert stall in Kuala Lumpur: noodles, coconut milk, and the price of one ringgit.
proof: Sold: about 5,000 customers a day, says the owner
